MOD = 1000000007

def multiply_power(p, exponent):
    res = 1
    for _ in range(exponent):
        res = (res * p) % MOD
    return res

def main():
    p, k = map(int, input().split())
    if k <= 1:
        num = multiply_power(p, p - 1 + k)
    else:
        num = 1
        used = [0] * p
        for i in range(1, p):
            if used[i]:
                continue
            num = (num * p) % MOD
            q = i
            while True:
                used[q] = 1
                q = (q * k) % p
                if q == i:
                    break
    print(num)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
